note: Blocks as they exist in the mosADD app. A skin changes how they look (the tokens listed), never what they do. sourceHint is where to start reading in the mosADD repo; it was not traced file by file.

functionalBlocks.name: Push-to-talk
functionalBlocks.does: Queue, recordings, transcripts; relayed by the server, never end-to-end encrypted.

functionalBlocks.name: Channels
functionalBlocks.does: Rooms for teams; readable by the service.

functionalBlocks.name: Scheduled jobs / own stream
functionalBlocks.does: An agent that acts on a timetable.

functionalBlocks.name: Team memory
functionalBlocks.does: Indexes team channels only, never 1:1 DMs.

functionalBlocks.name: Room on a website
functionalBlocks.does: A live room embedded on a domain.

functionalBlocks.name: Works without signal
functionalBlocks.does: Store-and-forward; local links as the core gains them.

uiBlocks.name: Thread wall (cards)
uiBlocks.describes: Cards of conversations with sender/channel, preview line, time, pin and menu.

uiBlocks.name: Conversation window
uiBlocks.describes: Header, message bubbles, voice notes, composer.

uiBlocks.name: Composer bar (ATTACH · PTT or field · switch · SEND)
uiBlocks.describes: Attach button, push-to-talk or text field, mode switch, send.

uiBlocks.name: mTALK push-to-talk button
uiBlocks.describes: The talk button with queue and floor states.

uiBlocks.name: mIRC channel header
uiBlocks.describes: Channel name, access label (server-readable), members, talk-target strip.

uiBlocks.name: Header with module switcher and filters
uiBlocks.describes: Module dropdown (mDM, mIRC, mAYL), search, filter tabs.

uiBlocks.name: Lidar / radar backdrop
uiBlocks.describes: Radar rings over the background; the skin may swap it for a plain fill or an image (theme.backdrop).

uiBlocks.name: mAYL inbox
uiBlocks.describes: Mail cards with sender, state tabs (inbox, sent, drafts…).

uiBlocks.name: mKEEPER (own stream)
uiBlocks.describes: Own notes, files and voice in one place. NO SCREENSHOT YET: the demo has no direct link to it.
